sections.description:
LOCAL AND THE TEHSIL ZAKAT AND USHR
LOCAL AND THE TEHSIL ZAKAT AND USHR
COMMITTEES (CONSTITUTION) RULES, 1979
[Gazette of N.‑W. F. P.,
Extraordinary, 24th July 1979]
No. PZA‑681/79.‑In
pursuance of the provisions of section 16 of the Zakat and Ushr (Organization)
Ordinance, 1979, at the direction and with the approval of the Central Zakat
Council, the North‑West Frontier Province Zakat Council makes the
following Rules for the constitution of the Local Committees and the Tehsil
Committees within the Province of the North- West Frontier :‑
1. Short title, application and commencement.‑(1) These rules
may be called the Local and the Tehsil Zakat and Ushr Committees (Constitution)
Rules, 1979.
(2) These shall apply to the
constitution of all the Local Committees and the Tehsil Committees in the
Province.
(3) These shall come into force
at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "adult" means a. person who is major as defined in
section 3 of the Majority Act, 1875 (No. IV of 1875) that is, of the age of 18
years or above ;
(b) "appointed place" means the place/venue fixed by the
District Committee under sub‑rule (1) of
rule 5 for the selection of members or for the election of the Chairman of
a Local Committee ;
(c) "appointed time"
means the date and time fixed by the District Committee under sub‑rule
(1) of rule 5 for the selection of members or for the election of the Chairman
of a Local Committee ;
(d) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of a Local Committee ;
(e) "Convener" means the Convener of a Team nominated
under sub‑rule (2) of rule 4 ;
(f) "election" means
election of the Chairman of a Local Committee ;
(g) "gathering" means the gathering of adult Muslim
residents of the locality, present at the appointed place and appointed time ;
(h) "member" means a
member of a Local Committee ;
(i) "Ordinance" means
the Zakat and Ushr (Organization) Ordi nance, 1979 ;
(j) "publicity" means
publicity through all possible means like the beat of drum, use of
laud-speaker, putting up notices at prominent public places, etc.;
(k) "selection" means selection of a member of a Local
Committee ; and
(1) "Team" means a
team constituted under sub‑rule (1) of rule 4.
3. Delimitation of Localities.‑The District Committee shall
delimit clearly and unambiguously the localities in the district and shall give
widest possible publicity to such delimitation, amongst the adult Muslim
residents of the localities concerned.
4. Constitution and functions of the Teams.‑(I) The
District Committee shall constitute Teams, each consisting of two or more
persons, including at least one non‑official, to organize selection of members and election of Chairman of
Local Committees.
(2) The District Committee
shall nominate one of the members of a Team to be the Convener of that Team.
The Convener shall be the leader of the
Team and act as its spokesman.
(3) The District Committee
shall require each Team to organize selection of members and election of
Chairman in one or more localities.
(4) The composition and
jurisdiction of the Teams shall be
duly publicised by the District Committee.
5. Selection/election programme of a Team and its publicity.‑(1) District Committee shall give to every
Team a progamme of work indicating clearly the venue, the date and the time of
the selection/the election in each locality.
(2) The District Committee and
the Teams shall give widest possible publicity, in the localities concerned, to
the programme of work given to a Team under sub‑rule (1).
(3) The programme of work under
sub‑rule (1) shall be so planned by the District Committee that the
residents of each locality get, at least seven days' notice of the
selection/election of their Local Committee.
